story_description: Ensure CLI features are validated against installed versions before use, preventing runtime failures when attempting to use unsupported CLI capabilities.
task_description: Extend CLIAvailabilityChecker to verify Codex CLI version supports app-server mode, comparing installed version against minimum required version constant before enabling app-server features.
atom_description: Add version comparison logic to CLIAvailabilityChecker that parses codex --version output, compares against CODEX_MIN_APP_SERVER_VERSION constant, and exposes supportsAppServer property on CLIStatus for Codex provider to gate app-server mode availability.
problem_statement: The current CLIAvailabilityChecker only verifies codex binary exists and can execute. App-server mode (required for structured JSON streaming) was added in a specific Codex version. Without version validation, Blaze may attempt to use app-server mode on older Codex installations, causing runtime failures or falling back to less reliable parsing modes.

Add version comparison function to check if installed version meets minimum requirement

scope_out: Checking app-server support for Claude or Gemini CLIs
Version checking for features other than app-server mode
Network-based version fetching or update notifications
Version history tracking or changelog display
